document.about: Owens Corning ProCat fact sheet. Its title is set right-aligned at 32pt over two lines, `PROCAT® PROFESSIONAL` over `LOOSEFILL INSULATION SYSTEM`, the ® raised to the cap height.

notes: 2026-11-24 (#176): a raised sign in a display title broke the title's line at the sign: the `®` 19pt up on 32pt type, or a `™` whose following space was set at the title's size.
2026-11-24: the title's two lines now read as one title, so the whole line is checked inside it.
2026-11-26: the document's title is a `doco:Title`, the document's header, apart from its sections, as a Word document's and a deck's are. The title's checks look for it there.

checks.issue: `PROCAT®` and `PROFESSIONAL` were two paragraphs on one baseline.
